title: discovery
description: Output of the discover primitive: what the input is, and where its target lives, resolved for the caller's goal. `target` is goal-dependent (a scope+contract, or a set of locations).

kind.description: what the input is (doc, code module, domain need, ...)

goal.description: what the caller asked to have determined

target.description: the goal-dependent result: a scope+contract object, or a list of located places

ambiguities.description: material determinations and how each was settled
